{{Quote|I have been told the fizzyglug is very good.|[[TC-38]]|<ref name="Kinect Star Wars">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''</ref>}}
'''Fizzyglug''' was a beverage popular with young [[Youngling/Legends|adolescents]].<ref name="RPG" /> It was bubbly and packaged in cans<ref name="HNN" /> and bottles.<ref name="RPG" /> Young [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] addicts would pour the liquid form of death sticks into Fizzyglug as the bubbles of the drink caused more of a rush when partaking in the narcotic.<ref name="HNN" />
